behavior_change: Callback registration lifetime, shutdown resource ownership/order, and prevention of new timers or recovery after Node Context closure; functional live-Context transitions, service results, production timeouts/retries and navigation algorithms remain unchanged.
local_build_option: GNU core target -fno-gnu-unique prevents implicit NODELETE and preserves actual component unload; no library pin
installed_byte_identity_scope: Unmodified extracted upstream header and package.xml matched the installed package before applying local source/test metadata changes.

local_test_metadata_change.test/CMakeLists.txt: Direct find_package(class_loader REQUIRED) supports the new real component-load/unload regression; production dependencies unchanged.

local_shutdown_ownership_fix.pre_shutdown: Log only; no worker resources, timers, joins or map destruction under Context callbacks.
local_shutdown_ownership_fix.destructor: Unregister callback; join service worker; cancel bond timer; release maps/bonds before Node base destruction.
local_shutdown_ownership_fix.client_parent: Empty-owner shared_ptr<Node> alias; manager-owned non-escaping clients do not retain parent manager.
local_shutdown_ownership_fix.bond_parent: Same borrowed Node alias, retaining the same Bond Node interfaces without worker shared_from_this reacquisition.
local_shutdown_ownership_fix.unsupported_boundary: Hot unload under a still-valid Context with a permanently unanswered RPC remains outside scope; bounded finite activation race is tested.
local_shutdown_ownership_fix.required_runtime_overlay: Sibling bondcpp4.2.0 Context-safe destructor overlay; existing dependency unchanged, local library resolution must be verified.
local_shutdown_ownership_fix.timer_creation: createBondTimer (200ms) and checkBondConnections respawn timer (1s): same Node Context validity precheck, RCLError suppressed only after that Context closes, otherwise rethrow; hard reset remains outside catch.
local_shutdown_ownership_fix.respawn_after_queries: Return after Node Context closure before successful-reconnection log or new startup.
local_shutdown_ownership_fix.respawn_before_control: Real paired Bond -> fixture pre-break -> worker hard reset -> held DEACTIVATE reply -> Context closes. Own-child gdb captured SIGABRT TimerBase -> create_wall_timer<ratio<1,1>> -> checkBondConnections. Actual wrapper has no fresh apport core; this stack is the controlled reproduction.
